definitions.explanation: Describes situations or problems that are serious in nature and require attention. Often implies negative consequences if not addressed.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}は{深刻|しんこく}です。
{深刻|しんこく}な{被害|ひがい}が{出|で}ています。
{状況|じょうきょう}が{深刻|しんこく}になってきました。

notes:
{深刻|しんこく} describes serious or grave situations, often with negative implications.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {深刻|しんこく}に (seriously)
- Noun modifier: {深刻|しんこく}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {深刻|しんこく}な{問題|もんだい} (serious problem)
- {深刻|しんこく}な{状況|じょうきょう} (grave situation)
- {深刻|しんこく}に{受|う}け{止|と}める (take seriously)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {真剣|しんけん}: serious (about attitude/effort)
- {深刻|しんこく}: serious (about situations/problems)
- {重大|じゅうだい}: serious, important (often for announcements)
